_doc: Every figure the skill can draw. kind: hairline = one of the 33 package figures (export_figures.js), iso = an isoart.py subject. depicts = what is literally drawn in the exported pose. topics = business themes it suits. avoid = themes it looks like it suits but does not.

figures.name: basket
figures.depicts: An empty wire shopping basket with a bail handle, tilted
figures.avoid: full or stocked shelves (it is empty)

figures.name: branches
figures.depicts: A commit graph on a board: a line of commits with a branch rising off it

figures.name: cabinet
figures.depicts: A server rack of twelve blades, one pulled out on its rails

figures.name: padlock
figures.depicts: A padlock with its shackle sprung open
figures.avoid: the shackle is OPEN in every exported pose (rest included): it reads as unlocked, breached or access. For 'secured' prefer vault or lockers
